candidate.name: Laguna DFlash IQ3_XXS selected-down output tiling
candidate.selection_scope: Laguna rows>1 target verifier only; the registered tile1 primitive remains the mandatory fallback and target c=1 AR is unchanged
candidate.mechanism: One local128 block computes two or four adjacent output columns for one selected lane. It loads each eight-value BF16 activation group once, applies the unchanged IQ3_XXS decode independently to each weight row, preserves every accumulator's group order, and uses the existing pair/quad reduction helpers whose per-accumulator wave and cross-wave addition order matches tile1.
why_selected: The family is 11.646 ms/cycle and 17.93% of target-verifier kernel time.
Unlike the larger raw-K bucket, it still reloads the complete activation row independently for every output column and has no output-tiled sibling.
Tile2 halves activation-row reads and workgroups; tile4 quarters them while keeping weight bytes and each output's arithmetic unchanged.
Current tile1 has enough resource headroom (VGPR32, LDS512, scratch0) for a bounded tile2/tile4 screen.
Fixed-budget changes do not solve the economics: B1/B2/B3 are all below B4 and all fixed budgets remain below true AR.
not_selected: Prompt/category/token-conditioned routing is forbidden benchmark gaming.
B1-B3 fixed budgets are exact but economics-negative.
Raw Q5/Q6 rowtile5 is larger but already weight-amortized and low-resource; there is no comparably direct exact reuse step without a new layout or arithmetic schedule.
IQ2 tile4 is deferred because the current tile2 already uses VGPR136; doubling accumulators risks spills.
Graph replay and stream overlap wait until device kernel work contracts; prior MTP graph/overlap attempts were neutral or negative and Laguna currently spends 64.96 ms in kernels.

red_green: RED collection fails on missing tile2/tile4 wrappers and registry keys.
Synthetic IQ3 blocks cover codebook/sign/scale branches, invalid experts, odd output tails, association-sensitive activations, BF16 edges, and rows 2/3/4/5/8.
Tile2 and tile4 outputs must be BF16-bit exact against registered tile1 for every row and output; CPU dequant KL/top-1 gate remains <=0.05/>=90%.

Actual B4 verifier must match tile1 for all 48 post-layer hidden rows, six DFlash captures, full logits/top-1, staged and committed K/V, all KVLiveSpans fields, reset/reuse, address stability, and lifecycle.
performance: A 50-warmup, 15-repeat counterbalanced actual-weight layer screen must show positive HIP-event and synchronized-wall time at representative early/late IQ3 layers.
Choose tile4 only if it is bit-exact, within resource bounds, and faster than tile2 at both endpoints; otherwise retain tile2 only.

A clean cached trace must name the selected kernel and improve the complete 45-launch IQ3 family, target-verifier kernel sum, target-verifier span, and whole-cycle wall without changing launch ownership outside the selected family.
The canonical ten-prompt/category+heldout h32 gate and ten-prompt h128 gate must remain exact and improve aggregate plus every-category DFlash decode; true AR must remain byte/performance unchanged.

This candidate may be retained as an exact explicit-DFlash improvement even if DFlash remains below AR. It cannot promote automatic DFlash routing unless the pre-existing >1.10x full-suite true-AR and no-category-regression policy also passes.

decision.reason: Current B4 is exact but only 0.6622x true AR at h32 and 0.6078x at h128. The profile is device-bound, and IQ3 selected down is the largest clear missing exact reuse transform.

source_lineage.note: This is a new in-tree specialization of the registered IQ3 selected kernel and existing pair/quad reduction helpers; unrelated historical manifest drift was reviewed and not copied.
